F14 WON’T Chatbot or live 
tutor support 
Implement a chatbot or live tutor support 
to provide real time assistance to the 
student; mirroring that of other eLearning 
platforms. 
Outcome: Enhanced personalised student 
support and content mastery, while 
attempting to cater to the needs of all 
students.  
F15 WON’T Support multiple 
exam boards 
Support the integration of multiple exam 
boards, including: AQA, OCR, and 
Edexcel. The student’s exam board should 
be selected during the registration 
process, enhancing user flow, while still 
offering the option to change this at a 
later date for specific subjects.  
 
Outcome: Ensures content relevance for 
students of diverse educational 
backgrounds, minimising extraneous load.
